title: FieldInput
description: Text field with optional scrubbable prefix, matching Figma property panel inputs. Supports $bindable value and oninput/onscrub callbacks.

prefix.description: Label shown in the left prefix area (e.g. W, H, R, PPI).

scrub.description: When true and prefix is set, the prefix acts as a ScrubHandle.

padLeft.description: Override for input padding-left (e.g. '28px' for longer prefixes).

oninput.description: Callback (val: string) => void after the value changes via typing or scrubbing.

onscrub.description: Callback (val: number) => void when the value changes via scrub only.
